gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-fs-neco: Wide, wired, unmistakable. Bruno Ace SC is happiest shouting a title in bowls that never thin out, while Neco, a text serif, does its best work in the mellow swell from hairline to stem.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-fs-recia: Recia has a sharp, authoritative look with only a whisper of modulation. Over a long passage its openings stay generous, and Bruno Ace SC's monoweight stroke up top keeps the whole thing crisp.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-alegreya: Alegreya has a literary hush, its contrast like a lightly flexed spring wire. And Bruno Ace SC supplies the pair's boldest quality, spread-out capitals with no thinning at the sides of the bowls.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-alegreya-sc: Traditional in spirit, Alegreya SC lets its wide-open s and gently graded curves carry the text beneath a heading built like bent neon tubing. Bruno Ace SC sets the tone; the body follows.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-alike-angular: Alike Angular reads like a classic serif stamped in soft metal, with a subtle thick and thin cadence and letters held open. Bruno Ace SC above it is one ribbon of constant width, and the two stay clearly apart.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-alyamama: Neon-bright up top, gently shaded below. The pair's strongest quality is the gap between Bruno Ace SC's monoline strokes and Alyamama, a classic serif whose soft thick-thin difference sits midway between flat and dramatic.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-ancizar-serif: Ancizar Serif reads bookish and editorial, its modest contrast like lightly engraved brass lettering. But the strongest thing here is the friction, because Bruno Ace SC keeps even the tail of its y as thick as the arm.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-andada-pro: Bruno Ace SC looks like laser-cut sheet, one stroke width all the way through. Andada Pro, a serif, does the opposite job well, with a medium ebb and flow of thickness and counters that let the eye slip in and out.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-aref-ruqaa: Aref Ruqaa reads with dignity, its open bowls welcoming the eye and its mild contrast staying friendly. And Bruno Ace SC, drawn with compass-pencil consistency, hands over to a gentle modulation that keeps paragraphs comfortable.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-aref-ruqaa-ink: Literary and classic, Aref Ruqaa Ink wears medium contrast with no harsh thin spots, under a heading like neatly bent pipe cleaner. Aref Ruqaa Ink keeps its apertures open, so a long passage should flow without tiring.
